t: This is the site of St Mary Rounceval, a hospital at Charing Cross. It was founded by William Marshal, 1st Earl of Pembroke, one of the great figures of medieval England. He was a soldier and statesman who served five kings: Henry II, Young Henry, Richard I, John and Henry III, as adviser, agent and warrior of outstanding prowess. Little of that world is visible here now, but this is one of his foundations.
